title: Unify resume-throttle and fallback signal for regional rejoin
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Fix: unify resume-throttle and fallback signal handling to prevent premature regional rejoin and reduce oscillation during load spikes; adds telemetry and opt-in feature flag for gradual rollout
description: Context: regional rejoin logic sometimes triggered immediately after transient health probes, causing oscillating failover behavior and unnecessary KV cache thrashing. Motivation: reduce oscillation and ensure rejoin only when sustained healthy conditions are observed while preserving fast recovery for true healthy regions. Approach: introduce a single combined signal (resume_throttle_and_fallback) that aggregates health probes, SLO debt, and circuit hysteresis into a deterministic state machine. The PR: 1) adds a small state machine in services/eviction/resume_throttle.go that coalesces probe events, SLO-credit metrics, and recent circuit flips into a single resume decision; 2) updates orchestrator to consult the unified signal before unmarking regional fallback, preventing immediate rejoin if any of the inputs remain degraded; 3) surfaces three new telemetry metrics (resume_signal_state, resume_signal_reasons, resume_debounce_ms) and normalizes naming in telemetry/metrics_mappings.yaml; 4) introduces an opt-in feature flag resume_unifier.enabled with gradual rollout via deploy/k8s/patches/resume-throttle-configmap.yaml; 5) adds unit and integration tests and a canary rollout helper script. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-1892) [x] unit tests for state transitions [x] integration tests for regional failover scenarios [x] added metrics and dashboards guidance [x] rollback plan included Testing: local unit tests plus CI regression; integration test simulates transient probe flaps and ensures region remains in fallback until sustained healthy window; played canary for 24h in staging with 0% increase in observed SLO violations. Rollback plan: revert feature flag to false or roll back the k8s patch; metrics expose fast indicator (resume_signal_state histogram) for rollback decision. Deployment: feature-flagged rollout, start at 1% region-trade, step to 10% after 3h, then 50% after 24h if stable. Migration notes: no DB schema changes; configmap key added but backward compatible. Risks: subtle timing bugs that might delay recovery in corner cases; mitigations: short debounce default (250ms) and emergency opt-out gate. Related: addresses SUP-5421 incidents during transient health probe storms.
commits_summary: 1) initial state machine and core logic; 2) orchestrator integration and API; 3) telemetry and metrics mapping; 4) feature flag and k8s patch; 5) tests and canary script; 6) docs and rollout notes
